source_health.name: NYC Cooling Tower Registrations
source_health.coverage_note: Coverage is normalized current systems represented in the generated product.

source_health.name: NYC Cooling Tower System Inspection Results
source_health.entity_unit: current cooling tower systems with published inspection history
source_health.coverage_note: Coverage is the share of current systems with at least one exact system_id inspection history; it is not an expected-completeness percentage.

source_health.name: OATH Hearings Division Case Status
source_health.coverage_note: Coverage is exact NYC Health summons_number to OATH ticket_number match coverage.

source_health.name: Primary Land Use Tax Lot Output (PLUTO)
source_health.coverage_note: Coverage is exact BBL match coverage; one BBL can attach to more than one cooling-tower system.

source_health.name: DOB NOW: Build – Job Application Filings
source_health.entity_unit: BBLs with DOB NOW job filings
source_health.coverage_note: Coverage is exact BBL job-filing coverage. A missing DOB NOW match means no matching DOB NOW job filing was returned; it is not evidence that no construction or mechanical work ever occurred.

source_health.name: DOB Job Application Filings
source_health.entity_unit: canonical BBLs with bounded legacy project evidence
source_health.coverage_note: Coverage is prevalence of bounded exact-BBL legacy DOB/BIS evidence: all explicit cooling-tower text plus recent mechanical/boiler/plumbing/equipment project records. It is not expected-completeness coverage and recorded applicants/owners are project roles, not service-provider claims.

source_health.name: Multiple Dwelling Registrations
source_health.coverage_note: Coverage is exact BBL registration match coverage. HPD registration applies only to qualifying properties, so low absolute coverage is not itself a failure.

source_health.name: Registration Contacts
source_health.coverage_note: Coverage is the share of exact-matched HPD registration BBLs with public contact rows.

source_health.name: NYC Planimetric Database: Cooling Towers
source_health.entity_unit: current cooling-tower BINs with mapped physical tower features
source_health.coverage_note: Coverage is the share of current registry BINs with at least one exact-BIN 2022 aerial-derived Planimetric cooling-tower feature. A missing physical match is not evidence that a registered tower does not exist, and a building-level physical feature is not a one-to-one System ID identity claim.

source_health.name: BUILDING
source_health.entity_unit: current cooling-tower BINs with current NYC building footprints
source_health.coverage_note: Coverage is exact BIN attachment of the current NYC OTI building-footprint layer. The footprint is used as roof/building context and does not change cooling-tower identity, compliance status, or Priority Score.

source_health.name: New York State Cooling Tower Registry Weekly Extract
source_health.coverage_note: Coverage is the share of current authoritative NYS extract rows represented by normalized unique Equipment_ID records. Missing coordinates do not remove equipment from the product.

source_health.name: New York Official Reports — Labor Law published decisions
source_health.entity_unit: current TowerSignal systems with exact subject-worksite matches in retained published Labor Law decisions
source_health.coverage_note: Coverage is prevalence of explicit subject-worksite addresses in official published Labor Law decisions that exactly match a current TowerSignal property address. Official Reports is complete for appellate decisions but only selected trial-court decisions; zero coverage is not evidence that no Labor Law filing or litigation exists.
status_reasons: Official Reports is complete for appellate decisions but only selected trial-court decisions
Published decisions are not a comprehensive Supreme Court filing or NYSCEF docket feed

source_health.name: NYC OTI Planimetric 2022 Water Tanks
source_health.entity_unit: current cooling-tower BINs with 2022 rooftop drinking-water tank polygons
source_health.coverage_note: Coverage is observed exact-BIN overlap between current cooling-tower buildings and the NYC OTI 2022 rooftop water-tank physical layer. A missing polygon is not evidence that a building has no current domestic-water tank.

source_health.name: NYC Drinking Water Tank Inspections and Audits Compliance Results
source_health.entity_unit: current cooling-tower BINs with DOHMH drinking-water tank oversight records
source_health.coverage_note: Coverage is observed exact-BIN prevalence of official DOHMH drinking-water tank oversight/compliance records among cooling-tower buildings, not an expected-completeness target. No match does not establish that a building has no tank or no private compliance records.

source_health.name: Self-Reported Drinking Water Tank Inspection Results
source_health.entity_unit: current cooling-tower BINs with certified-inspector self-reported drinking-water tank records
source_health.coverage_note: Coverage is observed exact-BIN prevalence of owner/certified-inspector annual drinking-water tank reports among cooling-tower buildings. Self-reported records remain distinct from DOHMH inspection/audit evidence and do not affect TowerSignal Priority Score.

source_health.name: NYC ACRIS recent property activity cache
source_health.entity_unit: cooling-tower BBLs with relevant ACRIS activity in the bounded window
source_health.coverage_note: Coverage is observed 365-day relevant-document activity prevalence across exact cooling-tower BBLs, not a source-completeness target. A BBL without a cached match is not evidence that no property transaction or filing ever occurred.
status_reasons: cache BBL universe differs from the current NYC tower snapshot; unmatched new BBLs await the next cache refresh
